notes.title: Layover Lovers released!
notes.content:
Greetings, moonlings!

Our past couple of years have been filled with slumps and silence but we're getting back into working on projects again.

It's taken a while but Layover Lovers is finally released on Steam! It's a short one as usual. We hope you'll like the story we have for it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2618830/Layover_Lovers/

Additionally, we are offering a few treats to celebrate this occasion!

Carpe Diem: Reboot is currently at its deepest discount for a week (until the 23rd).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/686760/Carpe_Diem_Reboot/

Without Romance now has an added Steam achievement.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1409610/Without_Romance/

And while we're at it, we might as well add a link to our first-ever project, Carpe Diem.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/423880/Carpe_Diem/

Don't worry about the messy capsules.

Extra Moonlit Works

In case you missed, we also have some projects outside of Steam.

The first 2 parts to our video miniseries Third Wheel are out on Youtube! The next parts are in the works.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33020476/b57434a77fd12e980a9956290dd0774d4af042ec.png

Our first original song, Endings, was released on Youtube and Spotify! We enjoyed experimenting and testing out the process of making this and we are keen on making more originals in the future.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33020476/5aedd7ab9d278befcfa1202cfbdfcfba8628ea4e.png

To close it off, here's a glance into some of our work-in-progresses.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33020476/c5af280c86cf20d20e6bbb39237930f9b41af05b.pnghttps://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33020476/3f8ac005e529472cad7a1eda695283c3b4e7ae3c.pnghttps://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33020476/2cae3015605eff9d7bbd851cfa5b164e3f0caa41.pnghttps://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33020476/1070832b87a9106c6db260791508264822106719.png

What kind of projects could they be? Join our Discord or follow us on Twitter to stay up-to-date!

Til next time!

notes.title: Without Romance released!
notes.content:
Hello! I hope you're doing well.

If you didn't know, Moonlit Works participated in the Summer Novel Festival 2020 and our entry, Without Romance, is now out on Steam. I hope you like it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1409610/Without_Romance/



Other Moonlit updates

Another short visual novel is coming out soon! Layover Lovers. A terminal love story.
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33020476/9b7b514a926e1fc9d53a8a7de8c0914141b13038.png

Stay tuned for updates on our current project as well. A rhythm visual novel titled Bubblegum Beat.
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33020476/fc3aeca21adfa7f6ff75909dc5b520ea7569d2ae.png

For more updates, follow us on Twitter or join us on Discord!

notes.title: Asset Update
notes.content:
What in the moon is this?!

We just wanted to let everyone know that we have updated this little project with [strike]new[/strike] better assets! We are very proud with how it turned out, despite the rather unambitious concept behind it. We've also added a new achievement for those who checks out the updated version!


But this is a five-year-old game. Why update it now?

Good question! There were two things that pushed us to go ahead with this idea. As you may know, Carpe Diem was a little solo project, and while it was well-received somehow, most criticism about it is regarding the low quality of its assets. We thought that improving it would let people enjoy the story more. Another reason is that we treat our Steam Creator's page as the team's online portfolio of some sort, and updating the assets of this project would help us make it appealing.


Can I still get the old stuff?

You can find the old version in the DLC. Eyzi wants to get rid of his old works entirely, but he agreed to leave it there. The new sprites, backgrounds, and music are so good, though! We highly recommend checking it out.




We hope you enjoy this update! Everyone who worked and helped with the update, as well as the translations, are all amazing.

While we're at it, We'd like to mention the current project of Moonlit Works. We have another visual novel in development. It is a music-centered story titled Bubblegum Beat. Below is an image of the two main girls: Nao (left) and Veni (right).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11002723/a2560e300a772770240f5ad9d0b5efcec478955d.png

You can find more project updates and other things on our Twitter!

Chill with us on our friendly Discord community if you're not in it yet!

If you wish to support our projects, you can become a patron!

notes.title: Support The Sequel
notes.content:
Just because it crashed doesn't mean it's over

After so many requests, and after a few months of trial and error, I finally came up with the perfect story for a sequel and I'm ready to do it. I have started writing the story but I thought I'd give you guys a heads up and a few information about it.

It will be titled 'Carpe Diem: Reboot' and, as you may have guessed already, Ai... reboots. It will continue exactly where the first one left off, but this time the story will revolve around Ai and her struggles. The last part of 'Carpe Diem' will even be included in the sequel as the prologue, but with better art, music, and interface.

The first one did really well but it had its shortcomings which I'd like to make up for in the sequel. It will be longer (about 3~5 hours of gameplay), and will have multiple endings. No more MS Paint-tier background art. Characters will have more sprites. There will be more than two soundtracks, and they're going to be way better. Last but not least, we will finally hear Ai's voice!

However, this project will be bigger, and I won't be able to do it solo like the previous one. This is where I need your support. I've started a Kickstarter campaign for it where the funds will be taken from. The funds will be used to pay for the assets that the sequel needs. To show my thanks for your support, you will receive a reward if the campaign turns out successful.

Kickstarter Link: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/178238554/carpe-diem-reboot

If you want to support the sequel but can't back it on Kickstarter, fret not. You can still show your support by upvoting the project on Steam Greenlight.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=681290328

I hope this gets enough support from the people because I'm really excited to show you what I have prepared for the sequel. If you think the first one was sad... then I'm even more excited.
